Definition: properly, compact (part of soil), i.e. loam
BiblicalUsage: The word names the compact clay ground, the loam of the Jordan plain, where Solomon had the bronze vessels of the temple cast, between Succoth and Zarthan. It appears only once, in the account of the casting.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God chose ordinary clay ground for the making of holy vessels, and He still shapes His work in plain places.
